FY2026: revenue above $67B for the first time, non-GAAP operating income $29B (+16%), cash flow from operations $32B (+54%), net cash outlay for capex $48B. RPO $638 BILLION, up 363% - 12% expected to be recognized in the next 12 months and another 34% between 13 and 36 months, percentages 'both expected to accelerate over the coming quarters based on our current long-term outlook'. FY2027 guide: total revenue +34% in constant currency (surpassing the five-year revenue CAGR in the long-term outlook), non-GAAP EPS $8.05 (+18% cc); Q1 cloud revenue +58% to 64%; revenues and earnings expected to accelerate in the second half as further megawatts come online. Long-term targets RECONFIRMED by the new CFO: +31% revenue / +28% EPS CAGR through FY2030.

items.signal_prefix: AI infrastructure: SIGNED $67B OF AI INFRA CONTRACTS THIS QU

set.signal: AI infrastructure (co-CEO Clay Magouyrk): SIGNED $67B OF AI INFRASTRUCTURE CONTRACTS THIS QUARTER, the majority either bring-your-own-hardware (BYOH) or prepaid, taking BYOH/prepaid customer contracts to $75B with 'no degradation in margin compared to our other contracts'. Delivered more than 1.2GW to customers in FY2026; FY2027 Q1 delivery approaching 1GW, nearly the same capacity as delivered in the previous four quarters combined. 'Four customers contracting for more than $8 billion this quarter' (diversification across the largest customers). Renewals: 35,000 GPUs from 59 customers came up in Q4 - 49% of those customers renewed for 92% of the GPUs, and most of the remaining GPUs were subsequently sold to other customers in the same quarter; GLOBAL GPU UTILIZATION 97.5%. 'Everything we see shows this market size is $trillions per year'; with the previously outlined 30%-40% margin profile, OCI 'should grow into an extremely large and extremely profitable business'. CFO Hilary Maxson, 'from a back-of-envelope standpoint': return on invested capital in the high 20s at a steady state at the project level once revenues have ramped, even higher for BYOH-type structures.

items.reason: 'Four customers EACH contracted >$8B' is not what was said ('four customers contracting for more than $8 billion this quarter'); non-renewed GPUs: 'Most' were resold, not all; market-size quote not verbatim; ROIC is the CFO's hedged back-of-envelope view; speakers named.
items.evidence: We continue to diversify across our largest customers, with four customers contracting for more than $8 billion this quarter.
